title: Anti-inflammatory effects of water-soluble polysaccharides from Annona squamosa L. pulp in LPS-induced zebrafish embryos: Network pharmacology-guided analysis and experimental validation.
authors: Zhong, Yu; Zhang, Licheng; Deng, Yiheng; Shao, Qinghui; Liang, Jiawei; Jiang, Gan; He, Qiuxing
one_liner_zh: 研究番荔枝多糖的抗炎抗氧化作用，虽含分子对接和MD模拟，但对象为多糖-蛋白互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: ETHNOPHARMACOLOGICAL RELEVANCE: Annona squamosa L. (custard apple) is widely used in traditional folk medicine across tropical regions for treating inflammatory conditions and metabolic disorders. However, the antioxidant and anti-inflammatory potential of water-soluble polysaccharides from the edible pulp (WPAS) has not been previously investigated. AIM OF THE STUDY: To evaluate the antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activities of WPAS and to explore its potential mechanisms using integrated computational approaches and zebrafish models. MATERIALS AND METHODS: The in vitro antioxidant capacity of WPAS was evaluated using DPPH radical- and hydroxyl radical-scavenging assays. DFT, network pharmacology, molecular docking, molecular dynamics simulation, QSAR, and PASS prediction were employed to characterize representative monosaccharide motifs that served as simplified structural proxies for WPAS and to generate exploratory hypotheses regarding potential interaction networks and inflammation-associated molecular markers. The in vivo anti-inflammatory effects were assessed in an LPS-induced zebrafish embryo inflammation model by evaluating ROS levels, neutrophil recruitment, inflammatory protein expression, and cytokine gene expression. RESULTS: WPAS exhibited concentration-dependent radical scavenging activity, with IC(50) values of 71.84 mug/mL for DPPH radicals and 804.6 mug/mL for hydroxyl radicals, indicating appreciable in vitro antioxidant potential, particularly against DPPH radicals. Monosaccharide-based computational analyses suggested MMP9-related interaction patterns within the in silico framework and indicated possible associations with pathway-related processes, including NF-kappaB, JAK-STAT, and PI3K-Akt-related processes. In LPS-challenged zebrafish embryos, WPAS exhibited favorable biosafety and significantly attenuated inflammatory responses in a dose-dependent manner, as evidenced by reduced intracellular ROS, decreased neutrophil infiltration, lowered protein levels of TNF-alpha, NF-kappaB p65, and MMP9, and downregulated mRNA expression of TNF-alpha, IL-1beta, and IL-6. CONCLUSION: This study provides the first evidence that WPAS exhibits antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activities. The protective effects observed in zebrafish were associated with reduced ROS production, decreased neutrophil recruitment, and changes in inflammatory marker levels, including NF-kappaB p65, TNF-alpha, and MMP9. These findings support the traditional use of Annona squamosa L. and highlight WPAS as a promising natural polysaccharide candidate for further investigation of its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties.
abstract_zh: 民族药理学相关性：番荔枝（Annona squamosa L.，释迦果）在热带地区的传统民间医学中被广泛用于治疗炎症性疾病和代谢紊乱。然而，来自其可食用果肉的水溶性多糖（WPAS）的抗氧化和抗炎潜力此前尚未被研究。研究目的：评估WPAS的抗氧化和抗炎活性，并利用综合计算方法和斑马鱼模型探索其潜在机制。材料与方法：采用DPPH自由基和羟基自由基清除实验评估WPAS的体外抗氧化能力。利用密度泛函理论（DFT）、网络药理学、分子对接、分子动力学模拟、定量构效关系（QSAR）和PASS预测来表征作为WPAS简化结构代理的代表性单糖基序，并生成关于潜在相互作用网络和炎症相关分子标志物的探索性假设。在脂多糖（LPS）诱导的斑马鱼胚胎炎症模型中，通过评估活性氧（ROS）水平、中性粒细胞募集、炎症蛋白表达和细胞因子基因表达来评估体内抗炎效果。结果：WPAS表现出浓度依赖性的自由基清除活性，对DPPH自由基的IC(50)值为71.84 μg/mL，对羟基自由基的IC(50)值为804.6 μg/mL，表明其具有可观的体外抗氧化潜力，尤其是对DPPH自由基。基于单糖的计算分析提示了在计算机模拟框架内与MMP9相关的相互作用模式，并表明与通路相关过程（包括NF-kappaB、JAK-STAT和PI3K-Akt相关过程）的可能关联。在LPS刺激的斑马鱼胚胎中，WPAS表现出良好的生物安全性，并以剂量依赖性方式显著减轻炎症反应，表现为细胞内ROS减少、中性粒细胞浸润降低、TNF-alpha、NF-kappaB p65和MMP9蛋白水平下降，以及TNF-alpha、IL-1beta和IL-6的mRNA表达下调。结论：本研究首次证明WPAS具有抗氧化和抗炎活性。在斑马鱼中观察到的保护效应与ROS产生减少、中性粒细胞募集降低以及炎症标志物水平（包括NF-kappaB p65、TNF-alpha和MMP9）的变化相关。这些发现支持了番荔枝的传统用途，并突显WPAS作为一种有前景的天然多糖候选物，值得进一步研究其抗氧化和抗炎特性。
